summary: Round 1 had no findings, so nothing needed to be fixed. Since then, src/ui/settings/SettingsScreen.tsx moved the onChange guard into withOpponentStyles(). The helper returns undefined while settings are still loading, and otherwise returns a spread copy with only showOpponentStyles changed (a boolean from the checkbox). The behaviour is the same as before. Every write still goes through parseSettings in writeSettings. The only other change is a test file. No new untrusted input, sinks, dependencies or secrets. No reachable vulnerabilities.
